reason: A DSH compatibility layer that imports and manages legacy Claude Code and Codex plugins, including supported Skills, MCP clients, and Hooks, through lifecycle controls and an API.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Claude Code 与 Codex 旧插件的导入、兼容运行及安装、启用、更新和卸载管理。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness compatibility layer for importing, running, and managing legacy Claude Code and Codex plugins through their installation and lifecycle operations.

capabilities: Fetches plugin sources from Git URLs, local directories, and archives
Parses and manages legacy Claude Code and Codex plugin structures
Installs, enables, disables, updates, and uninstalls compatible plugins
Runs supported plugin capabilities including MCP clients, Skills, and Hooks
Provides lifecycle management through a DSH Web settings interface and service API
